data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate recorded prior year reserve releases of $15.2 (2016: $23.3).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a prior year release in 2017. The opening (2016) gross claims outstanding was 418.9 (USD millions). The report states prior year reserve releases of $15.2 in 2017, reflecting favourable prior-year claims development which reduced previously held reserves. Overall direction is a release.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction is partially automated from scanned pages. Opening reserves (gross claims outstanding 2016) located in Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) on page 14 with reasonably high confidence. The explicit gross prior-year movement note could not be located with full certainty; a narrative sentence indicating "prior year reserve releases of $15.2 (2016: $23.3)" was found in the Managing Agent/Directors' report (page 3) and has been used as the prior year development (treated as a release: -15.2). No clear GROSS 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' table with an explicit insurance-liabilities column was unambiguously read; therefore the prior-year movement uses the narrative figure (confidence medium). Segmental premium breakdown lines (verbatim statutory class names and amounts) could not be reliably transcribed from the scanned images; gross_premium_mix left empty. Claims development triangle is present in the report but numbers were not reliably OCR'd; see _claims_triangle for metadata.
